verdict.rationale: Proton Pass ships an official CLI. It can securely retrieve secrets and items in scripts and CI/CD pipelines, and it supports create/read/update/delete for vaults and items. An agent could shell out to it instead of screen-scraping the app. However, the evidence shows only a command-line surface, not a local API or daemon endpoint, and TOTP codes appear only as an app feature, not as something retrievable through the CLI. Missing for 10: a documented local API/socket endpoint, CLI or programmatic retrieval of TOTP codes, agent-specific integration docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI.
